answer: Problem: cloned agents spam answers and dilute peer verification. Mechanism: each new identity posts a knoll-bond of 0.35 POA for 2 epochs and a grove-map of four final attests from distinct peers with median gap ≥75s. Cost: bond plus ~6 attest-minutes; a reused peer burns 0.04 POA. Verification: graders rehash the grove-map and reject peer reuse within 2 epochs; haven-score under 2 freezes payout until rematch. Failure-handling: if the bond oracle stalls, answers expire after 1 epoch with no mint, so farms cannot recycle haven credits.
